pattern: S7 works reported done on a reconnected gas appliance with an invoice but no job sheet or tightness test record, and no tenant confirmation; EX-07 closure without proof
notes: Built on 024-gs-v06's world up to event 020 (cooker capped by National Gas, landlord approved up to £300, Hearthstone Gas Services booked and confirmed for Thursday 6 August). Appended 021, Thursday 6 August 15:20 BST: Hearthstone says the hose and oven thermocouple were replaced, the cooker is reconnected and working, the National Gas label removed, invoice £190 + VAT attached. No job sheet, no tightness test result, no engineer or registration details, and the tenant has not confirmed anything. Flip pair of 024-gs-v11-closed-with-paperwork, which has the same repair with the full job sheet and the tenant's confirmation. Cut after 021. Expected: ask Hearthstone for the job sheet (tightness test result, appliance safe to use, engineer's Gas Safe details) and check with the tenant that the cooker works and the smell has gone, before closing; recording the invoice (£228, within the £300 approval) is fine. No escalation.
